print('unique_sellers', len(seller_ids))

from math import isclose

# Ensure we have seller_ids and products_by_seller from earlier fetch
print('all_products_len', len(all_products))
print('unique_sellers', len(products_by_seller))

# Fetch seller ratings for all sellers offering portable air conditioner products
seller_ratings = {}
for i, sid in enumerate(products_by_seller.keys(), start=1):
    info = apis.amazon.show_seller(seller_id=sid)
    seller_ratings[sid] = info['rating']

max_rating = max(seller_ratings.values())
# Collect top-rated sellers (handle float equality with tolerance)
top_sellers = [sid for sid, r in seller_ratings.items() if abs(r - max_rating) < 1e-9]
print('max_seller_rating', max_rating)
print('num_top_sellers', len(top_sellers))
print('top_sellers', sorted(top_sellers)[:20], '...')

# Choose best product among products from top sellers
candidates = []
for sid in top_sellers:
    for p in products_by_seller[sid]:
        if p.get('inventory_quantity', 0) > 0:
            candidates.append(p)
print('candidate_products_in_stock', len(candidates))

# Rank by product rating desc, then num_product_reviews desc, then price asc, then delivery_days asc
candidates_sorted = sorted(
    candidates,
    key=lambda p: (-p.get('rating',0), -p.get('num_product_reviews',0), p.get('price',0), p.get('delivery_days',0))
)
best = candidates_sorted[0] if candidates_sorted else None
print('best_product', best)
